title: Chat variables
hint: Values that prompt macros (setvar, getvar, setglobalvar) keep between replies
chatHint: Only this chat sees these. Presets set them on every reply, for example dice rolls and switches.
globalHint: Shared by all chats, for example a preset's theme. A change here affects every chat.
emptyChatHint: They appear after a reply whose prompt uses setvar. You can also add one yourself.
emptyGlobalHint: They appear after a reply whose prompt uses setglobalvar. You can also add one yourself.
name: Name
discardBody: Your edits to the variables will be lost.

dice.title: Dice rolls
dice.hint: Rolled by the prompt's roll macros for this reply

preview.title: Variables after macros
preview.hint: What the prompt's macros would leave behind. Nothing is saved, dice are rolled anew each time.
preview.changedHint: Highlighted names are set or changed by this prompt.
